route_ttl.description: How often to reload the route file /proc/net/ipv6_route, in milliseconds.

proxy_interface.description: The network interface to listen on for Neighbor Solicitation messages.

router_flag.description: Whether to turn on the router flag for Neighbor Advertisement messages.

timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for a Neighbor Advertisement message before invalidating the entry, in milliseconds.

ttl_ms.description: How long a valid or invalid entry remains in the cache, in milliseconds.

rule_address.description: The target IPv6 address to match against in the rule.

rule_method.description: The method used for handling the rule: 'static', 'auto', or 'interface'.
